name: BlockFin Holdings Limited
summary: Operating through its various units, BlockFin Holdings Limited provides an extensive portfolio of financial services. These offerings include comprehensive asset management, specialized investment and fund advisory, and diverse consultancy provisions. The company is also actively engaged in securities brokerage, furnishing services such as margin financing, underwriting, placing, and dealing. Additionally, it supplies expert guidance on corporate finance. Established in 2000, the firm maintains its headquarters in North Point, Hong Kong. It was previously identified as Bison Finance Group Limited, before its official rebranding to BlockFin Holdings Limited in November 2025.
